name: auto-potion
description: Automatically use items to recover HP when damaged.
effect: If the user has 50% of their HP or less after being damaged by an attack, they will use either a Potion, Hi-Potion, or X-Potion in this priority order, if the item is in your inventory.

name: auto-med
description: Automatically use items to cure status ailments.
effect: Causes the user to automatically use an item to remove status ailments that are inflicted on them. If multiple ailments are inflicted at once, or if the item for the ailment in question is not available, a Remedy will be used; otherwise, the status recovery item for that particular status will be used. Does not function if the user is inflicted with a status that incapacitates them or makes them uncontrollable.

name: auto-phoenix
description: Automatically use Phoenix Down on KO'd user.
effect: If an ally in the active party is KO'd, the user will use a Phoenix Down on the KO'd user. This can trigger multiple times from the same attack if more than one user is KO'd, but the user cannot revive themselves this way.

name: no encounters
